_comment: 1.27 Wildlife Album (src/systems/Wildlife.ts): wild animals visit the Wild Woods and the edge of the farm. A species is out on a local day with `chance` (from the farm seed and the date, the same on every device), during its hours `from`-`to` (local time, may wrap past midnight), only in `weather` if given and only on festival days if `festival`. `place` is 'farm' (just off the fields), 'glade' or a woods region id (that region must be open). Tap one to photograph it: the first photo puts it in the album, and a full set pays its reward once. Nothing is caught and nothing can be missed for good: every species comes back.

species.name: Red Deer
species.about: Grazes in the glade in the early morning, ears always moving.

species.name: Red Fox
species.about: Trots through the glade at dusk, tail held high.

species.name: Wild Rabbit
species.about: Nibbles clover in Mossy Hollow most of the day.

species.name: Hedgehog
species.about: Snuffles through the leaves of Mossy Hollow after dark.

species.name: Red Squirrel
species.about: Darts between the pines, cheeks full of seeds.

species.name: Barn Owl
species.about: Watches over Whispering Pines all night.

species.name: Mallard Duck
species.about: Paddles along Crystal Creek, quacking at nothing in particular.

species.name: Grey Heron
species.about: Stands perfectly still in the shallows on quiet mornings.

species.name: Common Frog
species.about: Only comes out to sing when it rains.

species.name: River Otter
species.about: Plays in the creek in the late afternoon. Very busy, very wet.

species.name: Brown Hare
species.about: Boxes and bounds along the edge of the fields at dawn.

species.name: Robin
species.about: Sings from the fence posts on sunny days.

species.name: Peacock Butterfly
species.about: Flutters over the farm's edges on warm, sunny days.

species.name: Badger
species.about: Shuffles past the farm at night, looking for worms.

species.name: Penguin
species.about: Comes by boat for festival days. Nobody knows from where.

species.name: Polar Bear
species.about: A very polite visitor on some festival days. Brings its own ice.

species.name: Panda
species.about: Naps under the Elder Oak around midday, now and then.
